title: File:Costa Atlantica Hanse Sail 2011.jpg
description: The same hull in her first life: Costa Atlantica at Warnemünde during Hanse Sail, 13 August 2011, bow-on from the quay with the name COSTA ATLANTICA on the bow, the enclosed observation deck above the bridge, and the yellow Costa funnel aft; the Warnemünde passenger ferry F-Warnow crowded with visitors in the foreground.
